scope_limits: One receive-only and one separately dispatched finite keyed case per keeper, watcher and both. This does not close the full P5 failure matrix or qualify all simultaneous failures, API/credential/partial startup, stall rejection/expiry, or repeated duty.

The two shipping fixed ARP helpers run as UID/GID65534 with NET_ADMIN effective/permitted only, bounding/inheritable/ambient zero and NNP0. DSP and control run as UID78666 without capabilities and NNP1. No claim that all active session processes have NNP1. Signal injector drops to UID/GID65534, zero capabilities including bounding/ambient, and NNP1; only stdio and two pinned pidfds remain before its temporary trigger socket opens.

For combined loss, both helpers are observed stopped before SIGKILL. The 100ms capability-free thaw watchdog exits normally on the completion byte; its timeout/EOF fallback was not exercised here. Owned ARP and exact64byte matching boot/interface/MAC journal intentionally survive. No manual ARP mutation is used for recovery.

Foreign ARP entries were observed before and after faults. This is not adversarial foreign-entry replacement/conflict or concurrent ownership testing. Reconciliation admits only the matching fixed8600 profile; actual6300 profile/kernel qualification remains open.

Each individual survivor clears owned ARP/journal. After both-death, ordinary explicit Start plus two fresh USB IQ captures and normal Stop reclaims and clears owned state, independently audited after both receive and keyed cases. Other root inventories precede their successor cycles; all successors additionally have fresh IQ and public Stop evidence.
Abnormal fault termination retains cleanup_unconfirmed rather than inventing a clean Stop. External inventories prove the stated resources are retired; successful explicit successors finish normally.

Each keyed case has one GUI key and source arm, >=350ms observed corrected tones before fault, and radio UNKEY/READY while desktop is stopped. Original desktop Stop write, ACK and subsequent original unowned READY are independently checked. No automatic RF retry or source rearm. Interrupted analyzer exports are not new IMD measurements.

Host pause/trigger/receipt timing includes transport and is not calibrated physical RF-stop latency or FPGA-to-process latency. LP is peak-hold with forward/net basis unconfirmed; absolute rawIQ scale and ADC headroom remain uncalibrated.

Temporary lab bootstrap/audit carriers and containers/directories are retired; existing diagnostic SSH container remains bench equipment. No persistent privileged installation or shipping arbitrary-signal endpoint was added. No AetherTX, processing-setting restoration or radio reboot.

Natural128sample/cold-bypass causes, whole-radio software-reboot hang, raw/extended/repeated speech, final integrated stock comparison, actual6300, final native packages and independent production release gates remain open.
